title: What Happens When You Get Brain Freeze?
sources: Cleveland Clinic, 'Brain Freeze' (brief but intense pain in the front part of your head; also called an ice cream headache; scientific name sphenopalatine ganglioneuralgia; triggered by cold such as ice cream, frozen or slushy drinks, ice cubes, popsicles; when your body senses sudden, extreme cold in the mouth or throat it tries to react and warm up; blood vessels throughout the head expand to let extra blood into the area for warmth, and this sudden change causes the pain; usually lasts a few seconds to two minutes; not serious, no medical attention needed; press your tongue or thumb against the roof of your mouth to transfer warmth, or drink something warm or room temperature): https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/21478-brain-freeze

Houston Methodist, Katie McCallum, 'What's Happening During a Brain Freeze?' (2020) (occurs when the roof of your mouth goes from its usual warm temperature to one that's much colder; blood vessels narrow and then widen; triggers the trigeminal nerve, which controls sensation, including pain, in your face; referred pain makes you feel it in your forehead and temples instead of your mouth; press and hold your tongue against the roof of your mouth): https://www.houstonmethodist.org/blog/articles/2020/jun/what-causes-brain-freeze/

Tease (next video): Cleveland Clinic Health Essentials, 'Goosebumps: What They Are and Why They Happen' (goosebumps, or piloerections, are an involuntary, automatic reaction of the sympathetic nervous system; tiny muscles contract at the base of each hair follicle; in animals it thickens fur and makes them look bigger: 'Think of a cat that puffs up and pulls back onto its hind legs while it hisses'): https://health.clevelandclinic.org/why-do-you-get-goosebumps

lines.text: What happens when you get brain freeze?
Spoiler: it starts in your mouth, not your brain.
Ice cream chills the roof of your mouth,
and your body rushes to warm it back up.

which senses pain in your face,
so your brain blames your forehead instead.
